criticalCorrectionToTheDispatchItself.claim: The dispatch states: 'the failing population is parcels that have dollars in cad_property, do have a baked snapshot, and whose snapshot lacks the dollar object. That is a real bake defect on real accounts, and nobody has read the list' and separately asserts the 38,060 CTX-HAYS-SPLIT geometry-only rows 'cannot be causing this refusal.'
criticalCorrectionToTheDispatchItself.counter_evidence: Cross-tabulated the full 38,197-row miss list against CTX-HAYS-SPLIT's own already-published split (_inbox/2026-09-09_ctx-hays-split_close.json) of this SAME 38,444-row anti-join population (present@2025, absent@2026) into 384 genuine-CAD-lineage vs 38,060 geometry-only/no-independent-CAD-signal. Result: 37,813 of the 38,197 misses (99.0%) are the source_file='stratmap25-landparcels_48209_lp.zip' / assessed_value-IS-NULL rows CTX-HAYS-SPLIT already classified as geometry-only; only 384 misses (1.0%) are the hays-export2.zip / assessed-value-recovered genuine-CAD-lineage rows. 37,813 + 384 = 38,197 exactly, with zero residual.
criticalCorrectionToTheDispatchItself.nuance: CTX-HAYS-SPLIT's 'no CAD signal' label was based on assessed_value/exemption_codes/living_area_sqft, none of which StratMap's TxGIO mapper populates (lib/cad-ingest/src/txgio/landuse.ts:143-146: landValue/improvementValue/marketValue ARE read straight from the shapefile's own LAND_VALUE/IMP_VALUE/MKT_VALUE attributes; only assessedValue is hardcoded null). Those three fields are what satisfy CADROLL_EXPECTATION_SQL's OR test, so the geometry-only population is NOT actually dollar-free -- it carries land/market/improvement values sourced from TxGIO's own parcel attributes (themselves ultimately CAD-derived, per the StratMap/TxGIO program's design, though via a different distribution channel than Hays' own tabular export). This is a live, evidenced correction to the dispatch's own framing: the dispatch's claim of disjointness between the geometry-only population and the cadRoll-miss population is factually wrong at the 99% level, and the 'real bake defect on real accounts' framing applies cleanly to only 384 of the 38,197 misses (1.0%).
criticalCorrectionToTheDispatchItself.importance: This changes the practical severity read, not the code-level mechanism finding: whether framed as 'real accounts' or 'geometry-only StratMap rows,' the ROOT CAUSE (CADROLL_EXPECTATION_SQL's missing tax-year scope) and its FIX LOCATION are identical either way. What changes is how urgently a fix is needed and what data-quality follow-up (if any) belongs to CTX-HAYS-SPLIT's still-open operator question about the geometry-only population's honest absence state.
